title: Top Sidebar Widgets
text:
## Top Sidebar Widgets
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000103064
This article highlights the top sidebar widgets frequently used across various site pages, including profile pages, search results, and post pages. It is designed to help site admins select the best widgets to enhance page sidebars and improve user experience.
While it doesn't include every widget option available, it focuses on the most popular and effective choices.

## Adding Widgets to a Sidebar
To search for and add widgets to sidebars:
Go to Toolbox
Select Sidebar Manager
Find the desired sidebar and click " Edit "
Search for the widget
Drag and drop it into the sidebar
Save
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180303636/original/f-EhdMR16Np2ovUh6jErepZlW2pnUMoP4w.png?1781237902 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12155696204/original/T-rZ5DXUGAxYq5h6RqZAmzCcN1Ip8lmyKQ.gif?1737431893 | alt: ]
Throughout this article, each widget is listed with its reference in the format [widget=...] . This is the widget's name — search for it in the Sidebar Manager to find and add it.
More information:
Sidebar Alignment: Design Settings » Sidebar Alignment Options
Sidebar Manager Overview : Toolbox » Sidebar Manager
How to Create a Sidebar

## Universal Sidebar Widgets
These widgets can be added to any page and will retain their intended functionality.

## Sidebar Videos & Text Boxes
Enhance the website sidebars with videos and custom text boxes to showcase important content, promotions, or helpful resources.

## Video
Add videos to sidebars by creating a new widget and inserting the embed code: How to Add a Video in a Sidebar

## Text Box
Add a custom text box to sidebars by creating a new widget and inserting the text content: How to Create a Text Box to Display Text in a Sidebar

## Banner Ads on Sidebars
The process of adding banners to any sidebar can be found here: Adding Banners to Sidebars

## Notes
Dynamic search modules and regular search modules can't be used on the same sidebar.
Custom widgets can also be added, the functionality will depend on the custom code.
